explanations.trigger_explanation: When a federally funded, permitted, authorized, or carried-out action may affect listed species or critical habitat, Section 7 consultation with the United States Fish and Wildlife Service is commonly required.

known_unknowns: For some species or marine resources, National Marine Fisheries Service consultation may also be required.
advisories: Additional review recommended where listed species, critical habitat, or other federal trust resources may overlap the project area.
notes: Confidence tier 1 because the consultation trigger is directly supported by federal regulation and official United States Fish and Wildlife Service guidance.
